prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME] for the client, [LOSS_DATE] for the accident date and [DEMAND_AMOUNT] for the money demanded. Say an expert review supports a permanent injury and give the insurer 30 days to pay. No other names or dates.
text:
Dear Claims Representative:

This firm represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with injuries sustained in the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. The available evidence establishes that your insured failed to stop at a controlled intersection and struck our client's vehicle broadside. Police documentation of the scene, photographs of the damage, and witness statements all point to the same conclusion: liability rests squarely with your insured.

Our client sought immediate medical care and has since undergone extensive treatment, including imaging, physical therapy, and specialist consultations. A review by a qualified medical expert has concluded that our client suffers from a permanent injury that will affect daily function and earning capacity for the foreseeable future. The treatment records and the expert's written findings are enclosed for your review.

Based on the medical costs incurred to date, projected future care, lost income, and the permanent nature of the injury, our client demands payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve this claim.

You have thirty (30) days from the date of this letter to tender payment in full or to make a written settlement offer. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are prepared to file suit without further notice and to seek all damages available under the law.

Please direct all communications regarding this matter to my office.

Sincerely,

Attorney of Record
